'''Petra Olmanova''' is a ship [[Engineers|Engineer]] based at '''Sanctuary''' in the '''Asura''' system of the Colonia region. A former specialist combat technician, she survived an explosion at Consolidated Plasma Corp's primary research facility before resurfacing as an independent engineer.<ref name="edwiki-petra">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Petra_Olmanova Petra Olmanova], Elite Dangerous Wiki; in-game biography and legacy service record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Olmanova provides Grade 5 Engineering across armour, reinforcement modules, explosive weapons, and defensive utility equipment.<ref name="inara-petra">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/24/ Petra Olmanova — Engineer], INARA; current access, location, reputation, and service record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Sanctuary is a surface Engineer base on Asura 1 d, approximately 3,243 Ls from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-sanctuary">[https://inara.cz/elite/station/67081/ Sanctuary — Station], INARA; current facility and location record. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Access requirements ==

{| class="wikitable"
! Stage
! Requirement
|-
| Discovery
| Receive a referral from [[Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn]] after reaching Grade 3 access plus at least one-third progress toward Grade 4.
|-
| Meeting
| Reach '''Expert''' or higher in Combat rank.
|-
| Unlock
| Deliver '''200 Progenitor Cells''' at Sanctuary.
|}

Progenitor Cells are a cargo commodity rather than an Engineering Material. The complete ordered process, including commodity acquisition and travel preparation, belongs to [[Unlocking Petra Olmanova]].<ref name="newp-engineers">[https://newp.io/engrhighlight Engineer Highlight], New Pilots Initiative; Colonia Engineer access summary. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

{{Field note|INARA reports that station services may not appear immediately after the workshop is unlocked. Relogging should make them available.<ref name="inara-petra" />}}

== Reputation ==

Olmanova's Engineer reputation is increased by crafting Engineering modifications at Sanctuary. Current records do not list a secondary reputation method.<ref name="inara-petra" />

She does not provide a direct referral to another Engineer.

These blueprints apply only to compatible Merc modules and use Merc Coins in their Engineering costs.<ref name="inara-mrp-heavy">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/214/ Module Reinforcement Package — Heavy Duty], INARA.</ref><ref name="inara-seeker-drag">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/219/ Seeker Missile Rack — Drag], INARA.</ref><ref name="inara-seeker-exposing">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/227/ Seeker Missile Rack — Exposing], INARA.</ref><ref name="inara-seeker-lightweight-thermal">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/220/ Seeker Missile Rack — Lightweight Thermal], INARA.</ref><ref name="inara-seeker-lockdown">[https://inara.cz/elite/blueprint/221/ Seeker Missile Rack — Lockdown], INARA. Records retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

Frontier's Rhino update specifically corrected an issue that had prevented Seeker Missile Rack MercGear from being engineered with Olmanova.<ref name="frontier-rhino">[https://www.elitedangerous.com/news/updates/4-4-1-0 Elite Dangerous — 4.4.1.0 Update Notes], Frontier Developments, 2 September 2026. Retrieved 11 September 2026.</ref>

== Blueprint pinning and remote work ==

After sufficient reputation has been earned, one Olmanova blueprint can be pinned for use through [[Remote Engineering]]. A pinned blueprint cannot exceed the grade she offers, and Experimental Effects still require a visit to an appropriate workshop.

== Referral position ==

Olmanova is a direct Colonia referral from [[Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn]]:

<pre>
Tod "The Blaster" McQuinn
└── Petra Olmanova [Colonia]
</pre>

[[Selene Jean]] is a parallel referral from McQuinn rather than a prerequisite for Olmanova. Olmanova is terminal in the current referral network.<ref name="inara-petra" />
